title: Quadratic count budget
statement: Let $n,k,l,T,R,a$ be natural numbers with $T\le n$, $R\le T$, and $a\le 2n+4+k(3n+7)+(4l+7)(T+1)^2$. Then $a+R+4\le (10+10k+8l+7)(n+1)^2$.
replaced: For all naturals with $R \le T \le n$ and a recording time within the standard recording ledger, the recording time plus $R + 4$ is at most $(10 + 10k + 8l + 7)(n+1)^2$: the same argument envelope pays for returning one final count instead of the full trajectory, including its physical output and halt.
